meta.name: screenshot
meta.description: Take screenshots of web pages for blog posts, documentation, and marketing. Capture full pages, specific elements, dark mode, and custom dimensions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 截取网页整页、元素或自定义尺寸的清晰截图
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常需要为文章、文档或营销页面抓取网页截图
copy.tagline_en: Capture full-page, element, or custom-size screenshots of any webpage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need webpage screenshots for content or docs

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以运行脚本截取指定网址的网页图片，支持整页、指定网页元素、暗色模式、自定义宽高等选项，产物是图片文件。
howto.when: 当你请 Claude 为某个网址截图并提供保存文件名时触发；脚本会按你给的宽高、暗色、选择器等参数执行。

say.text: 截取 https://example.com 整页，保存为 page.webp。
say.note: 会生成一张整页长截图。

say.text: 用暗色模式截取这个页面。
只截取页面上 header 部分。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can run a script to capture screenshots of given URLs and save them as image files. It supports full-page, specific elements, dark mode, and custom dimensions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to screenshot a URL with an output filename; it runs the script with options like width, height, dark mode, or a CSS selector.

say_en.text: Take a full-page screenshot of https://example.com as page.webp.
Screenshot this page in dark mode.
say_en.note: The image will have a dark background.

say_en.text: Capture only the header element on the page.
say_en.note: Only that element area is saved.
